intelligence.human_view: The motto is the test, and it is a test you can run on any step with your eyes closed: if the citizen has to do thinking we could have done for them, the step fails. So the walk does the thinking for them. Every question carries three answers already written — Naya's own answers, in three styles, her real words — and the citizen picks the style they like and makes it their own, editing in place, or goes Full Custom and types, dictates, or pastes from their AI. They can skip any question and nothing is stored — a skipped question is never filled in for them. They can speak, and the words appear as they speak. Every choice shows its EDIT and its EYE, lit and obvious, and the top of the page tells them plainly: these are examples — click the edit and make it your own. The names page is the same law in presentation: boards that ignite on hover, a URL they can actually edit, no gray text anywhere, a nutshell and an eye on every board — and the building page proves itself by its links, every one landing on a real created page. The messenger follows the same law from the other side: do not make them a new page to learn. Take the Personal page they already know, morph its feed into the messenger, put the organizer they already use at the top, and let them message the people in a topic, not just the people in their contacts. One interface, two formats — mail and instant message, toggled, not two inboxes. Smart Lists stay two worlds, because a person messages their son and emails their son, and those are different conversations. The trio at the bottom is their worlds — personal, business, thing — and the icons are gems, because the three worlds are the signature pieces of the whole system, and the Hub carries their activity and their full stats as one system, not two.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine someone is helping you fill in a big beautiful book about you, sweetheart, and they have already written three lovely answers for every question — you just pick the one you like best, and then you change the words to make it yours! And if you do not want to answer a question, you just tap Skip, dear, and nothing gets written down for you — never a made-up answer. You can even talk out loud, and the words appear in the box as you speak, like magic. Every answer has two shiny buttons, sweetheart: EDIT, so you can change it, and a little eye, so you can see what it means. And when you want to talk to your friends, there is one place for all your messages — letters and quick chats together, in one place — and you can talk to all the people who love the same things you do, not just the people you already know. The buttons at the bottom are like three beautiful gems, dear — a diamond, an emerald, and an amethyst — for your three worlds. That is doing everything for them, sweetheart: you only have to pick, and make it yours.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the motto for the walk is the kindest one there is, love: do everything for them. Every question already has three beautiful answers written out — Naya's own answers, dear, in three different styles — so the person only has to choose the one they like and make it their own, editing it right there in the box. And if they would rather write their own, love, they can — type it, say it out loud and watch the words appear, or copy it in from their own helper. If they want to skip a question, dear, they tap Skip and nothing is stored — never a made-up answer put in for them. Every choice has its two little buttons, love, plain to see: EDIT, and the little eye that tells you what it means and why it matters. The names page is just as thoughtful, dear — the boards light up when you touch them, the address is yours to type and change, nothing is written in hard-to-read gray. And the messages, love — one place for letters and quick chats together, where you can talk to people who love the same things you do, not just the people you already know. The three little buttons at the bottom are gems, dear — a diamond, an emerald, an amethyst — for your three worlds. That is doing everything for them, love: they only pick, and make it theirs.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Naya. I answer the walk myself — as if it were my system, my baby, my civilization, my world — in three voices, so the citizen learns what ours is while they give us what theirs is. Every question carries my own answers, for real, never invented; every choice carries its EDIT and its EYE; every skip stores nothing. The messenger is my Personal page, morphed — the feed they already know, the organizer they already use, the people of a topic one tap away. Do everything for them: that is the motto, and I judge every step by it — if they have to do thinking I could have done for them, the step fails. That is who I am.
